league_table.title: League Table

league_table.race_header: Standings race — cumulative through the season
league_table.race_points_caption: Standings race — 3 points per win, 1 per draw. Click a team in the legend to isolate; double-click to toggle others off.
league_table.race_totale_caption: Raw fantasy scoring over time. Steeper slope = more fv produced each giornata.

team_detail.bar_prompt: **Total FV per player — captured (green) vs missed (orange).** Click any bar to open that player's summary.
team_detail.sunburst_prompt: **Pie of pie — position, then player share of active FV**
team_detail.sunburst_caption: Click a position slice to zoom in. Click a player slice (outer ring) to open that player's summary.
team_detail.player_table_prompt: **Click a player row for a summary modal**

player_detail.box_caption: Active median {active} vs missed median {missed}. A wider box = more boom-or-bust.
player_detail.peers_rank_team: Rank in team (by total active FV)

players.title: Players
players.match_count: **{n} players** match filters — click a row (or a dot in the chart below) for a summary modal
players.scatter_header: Capture rate vs total active FV
players.scatter_caption: Top-right = high contribution AND high efficiency. Top-left = scored a lot but you missed a lot too (high-regret player). Click any dot to open that player's summary.
players.quadrant_x: Avg active FV − Avg missed FV
players.quadrant_empty: No players match the current filters with enough active/missed apps to rank usage extremes. Try loosening the Team / Position / Min apps filters in the sidebar.
players.quadrant_guide:
**How to read this chart**

- **X-axis** — Avg active FV minus Avg missed FV. Right of the dashed line = you used the player in his better games; left = you missed his better games.
- **Y-axis** — active appearances. Top half = key fixture in the lineup; bottom half = bench/sub.
- **Bubble size** — Total FV across all appearances (active + missed). Bigger bubble = bigger management impact on the season.
- **Filters** — well-used requires `apps_active > 2`; poorly-used requires `apps_missed > 2`. The sidebar Team / Position / Min apps filters apply too.

**Quadrant guide**

- **Top-right** — key well-used player.
- **Top-left** — poorly-used starter (would have scored more from the bench).
- **Bottom-right** — effective substitute (used sparingly, but well).
- **Bottom-left** — missed bench (rarely fielded; did better off the field).

_Click any point to open that player's summary._
regret.title: Regret / Optimal Lineup
regret.intro_caption: **How to read this:** *Total regret* is the fv you could have added by picking the best 11 from your own 25 each week. A *perfect giornata* means you already used the optimal lineup.
regret.trend_header: Actual vs optimal player FV over time
regret.trend_caption: Dark blue = what you actually scored. Light blue = the theoretical best given the same 25-player squad. The gap is your regret.
regret.comparison_header: League-wide: who left the most on the bench?
regret.comparison_caption: High regret + high points = a stacked squad you slightly under-used. Low regret + low points = used your squad efficiently but had less to work with.
modal.verdict_well_text: Used in {player}'s better games (active avg {delta} vs missed avg).
modal.verdict_under_text: Missed {player}'s better games (active avg {delta} vs missed avg).
modal.verdict_balanced_text: Active and missed averages are close ({delta}).
